context.transcript:
I'd like to thank the members of the media for attending today's press conference.
I'm Carlos Abrantes, founder and CEO of Abrantes Incorporated.
It's amazing to think I started our environmental consulting firm with a few friends just five years ago.
Now we have over 300 people on staff and they're the best in the business.
It's because of them that our work on some of the largest wastewater projects in the world has been so successful.
In recognition of this, I'm announcing that employees will now be able to purchase shares of stock in the company.
I'm very excited to offer this investment opportunity to our staff.
context.transcript_translation:
我要感谢媒体成员出席今天的记者招待会。
我是 Carlos Abrantes，Abrantes Incorporated 的创始人兼首席执行官。
想到我五年前只和几个朋友创立了我们的环境咨询公司，真是令人惊讶。
现在我们有超过 300 名员工，他们是业内最优秀的。
正是因为他们，我们在全球一些最大的废水处理项目上的工作才取得了如此成功。
为表彰这一点，我宣布员工现在可以购买公司的股票。
我非常激动能将这个投资机会提供给我们的员工。
